text:
Maya (DevEx PM): Quick async sync — aiming for changelog/docs/SDK/quickstart cutoff EOD Wed (2024-05-17). Need owners to confirm merged + sample apps smoke green. Mini checklist:
1) SDK PRs merged (tagged)
2) Docs PRs merged + snapshots updated
3) Quickstart containers built and published
4) Sample apps updated for new auth init signature
5) Changelog bullets added for any breaking or notable changes

Links: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/234 (SDK), https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 (docs), changelog PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/301

Aaron (SDK Eng): On PR #234 — CI passed, just waiting for one more LGTM. I updated the init to `Client({apiKey, region})` so docs need that snippet updated. @Priya can you confirm? :eyes:

Priya (Docs): Saw the change. I left a TODO in the docs PR to switch the quickstart snippet to the new init. I'll push the change before lunch.

Lin (Infra): I'll merge the runtime patch that Aaron mentioned by 11:30. Heads up: quickstart container builder now needs `--build-arg SAMPLE_ENV`; Sam, does the sample apps image rely on that?

Sam (Samples): Yes — sample apps expect SAMPLE_ENV=prod for the baked-in config. If Lin merges the runtime change I'll rebuild images and run the smoke harness. One heads-up: sample-runner has a flaky test: `auth: should exchange token` failing ~1/10. Filed bug #45: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/45 :warning:

Olga (QA): I can run the smoke matrix this afternoon (linux/mac/win). Please drop the exact commit sha I should test. Also, I'll try to reproduce the auth flake locally.

Maya (DevEx PM): SHA for the SDK PR head is `abc1234`. Use that for quick checks. Also, please add short changelog bullets to PR 301 by 4pm so we can compile release notes.

Aaron (SDK Eng): Merging now, will tag `v1.4.0-rc1`. :shipit:

docs-bot: Preview site available for PR 987: https://deploy-preview-987--docs.redwood.ai/ (expires in 48h)

Priya (Docs): Updated quickstart snippet and snapshot. Replaced `new Client()` example with:

```js
import {Client} from '@redwood/devex';
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, region: 'us-west-2' });
```

Sam (Samples): Image rebuild started. Command I ran: 

```bash
docker build -t redwood-quickstart:latest . --build-arg SAMPLE_ENV=prod
```

Sam (Samples): Smoke: macos ✅, linux build failed due to missing `RW_API_KEY` in CI env — adding fallback to README and updating CI job.

Olga (QA): Running full smoke now on `abc1234`. I'll post pass/fail matrix in ~30m.

Maya (DevEx PM): Reminder: if we still have red CI by EOD we'll slide the public cut. If any owner can't meet their item, reply here with exact blocker so we can escalate. Thanks all. :pray:

Lin (Infra): Merged runtime patch and updated the builder to accept SAMPLE_ENV by default. Dropped a note in infra-ops channel.

Aaron (SDK Eng): Tag pushed `v1.4.0-rc1` and release draft created. Added short blurb to changelog PR 301: "SDK: init signature changed to require region param; docs updated."

Priya (Docs): Changelog bullets added + small grammar cleanup. :white_check_mark:

Olga (QA): All smoke checks green on `abc1234` except reproducible flaky auth test — tracking in #45. Matrix: macos/linux/win => pass/pass/pass.

Sam (Samples): Updated sample apps README with fallback env instructions and a note about the auth flake. Pushed sample tag `samples:20240517-abc1234`.

Maya (DevEx PM): Awesome — thanks everyone. Unless anything else pops up, I'll ship RC after the changelog gets final review. If you want to add a line to the release notes, drop it into PR 301 before 4pm. :tada:
